title: AAPS Random restart since upgrade to V2.7
symptom: Since upgrade to AAPS 2.7, the app restarts on its own a few times a day randomly, whether using another app or not. No issues with 2.6.1. In a later comment, the problem persists in 2.8, with logcat showing an AutoPowerKill that kills the app.
cause: The thread does not establish a definitive root cause. The maintainer says it is phone specific and cannot help. The user suggests it may be due to Xiaomi's power management (dontkillmyapp.com/xiaomi).
fix: No definitive fix is stated. The maintainer suggests testing dev version or trying phone-specific settings from the About dialog. The user considers changing ROM or reverting to MIUI 11.
evidence_quote: it's phone specific. I cannot help. Did you try everything specific for your phone on page accessible from About dialog?
